deviation_mechanism: Mid-stack layer thicknesses expanded beyond 1000 nm, accumulating excessive optical path difference (OPD). In the MWIR band, such deviations introduce wavelength-dependent phase errors and amplify sensitivity to material dispersion coefficients, effectively breaking the designed quarter-wave interference condition. The optimizer likely converged to a local minimum characterized by thickened central layers that satisfy amplitude constraints loosely but destructively interfere spectrally, lowering the overall target score.
